summary: sc-font-icons resolves its sole dependency from an off-registry HTTPS tarball
details: package.json declares the only dependency `ltidisafe` as an HTTPS tarball URL (https://ltidi.storage.googleapis.com/depenconf/ltidisafe-3.9.6.tgz) rather than a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches and installs whatever bytes that URL returns, without a registry integrity hash and without any registry-side review, executing any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched tarball. The shipped index.js is an empty stub, so the manifest is the entire install-time surface. The version `99.9.1` is implausibly high relative to typical icon-package versioning, consistent with a resolution-winning squat. Whoever controls that storage bucket controls code executed on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
